mapper.insert: insert into mcp_tool_binding ( org_id, gateway_id, tool_id, bind_type, bind_target_id, enabled, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{orgId}, #{gatewayId}, #{toolId}, #{bindType}, #{bindTargetId}, #{enabled}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: select id, org_id, gateway_id, tool_id, bind_type, bind_target_id, enabled, created_at, updated_at from mcp_tool_binding where org_id = #{orgId} and bind_type = #{bindType} and bind_target_id = #{bindTargetId}
